title: Hats
wikitext:
[[File:Hat Shop.png|200px|thumb|right|The hat shop in [[fall]].]]

'''Hats''' are cosmetic [[clothing]] items that alter the appearance of [[The Player|the player]] but otherwise have no effect.

Hats cannot be sold through the [[Shipping|Shipping Bin]], to the [[Abandoned House|Hat Mouse]], or to any store/shop in the game.

==Obtaining hats==
The day after earning their first [[Achievements|Achievement]], players will receive a letter from the mouse in the [[Abandoned House]] alerting them that hats can now be purchased there. Most [[Achievements]] unlock a new hat for sale.

A few hats can only be obtained at certain [[festivals]], the [[Casino]], the [[Adventurer's Guild]], or in [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] in the Skull Cavern.

Many hats can also be [[Tailoring|tailored]] at the sewing machine in [[2 Willow Lane|Emily's house]] or the [[Sewing Machine]] received as a reward for the [[Quests#Rock Rejuvenation|"Rock Rejuvenation"]] special order.

There is a small chance to receive certain hats from slaying [[monsters]], breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]], chopping [[trees]], shaking trees with seeds, digging [[Artifact Spot]]s, or [[Pans|panning]].<ref name="rarecosmeticdrop" /> These hats are indicated below in the "How to Obtain" column with "Random drop during various player actions".
